reuse.why: Reuses findOrCreateBank, syncAccount, handleSyncResponse and getServer, but the new linkFintegraAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions are fresh copies of existing provider bodies, and link replacement re-writes unlinkAccount's field reset.

duplication.why: Adds a sixth copy of the upgrade-or-insert account/payee/sync body, another copy of the download-and-map routine, and a copy of unlinkAccount's account-reset update; each link function also repeats the same two guard calls.

placement.why: Guards and the link handler live in accounts/app.ts, the download in accounts/sync.ts, config in server-config.ts and types in types/models, as the tree organises providers.

scope.why: Covers the four requested link changes; widening DbAccount.account_sync_source is a reasonable typing fix but beyond the request.

maintainability.why: The link rules are in two named guards, but every provider must call both in the right order, and the copied link and download bodies keep growing.

bypasses_abstraction.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked resets the old account with its own db.updateAccount instead of going through unlinkAccount (deliberately, per its comment).

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount compresses the existing provider link body (one-line if/throw, inline insertPayee) and downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes the SimpleFIN/Pluggy download with different error handling, rather than sharing it.

abstraction_drift.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked gains a replaceExistingLink flag and a branch that resets the other account instead of throwing; all six link functions call it.
